mapper.select: SELECT REGION_ID AS regionId , ROUTE_NO AS routeNo , BUCKET AS bucket , METERS AS meters , SECONDS AS seconds FROM BUS_ROUTE_SPEED WHERE REGION_ID = #{regionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BUS_ROUTE_SPEED (REGION_ID, ROUTE_NO, BUCKET, METERS, SECONDS, FIRST_SEEN, LAST_SEEN) VALUES (#{speed.regionId}, #{speed.routeNo}, #{speed.bucket}, #{speed.meters}, #{speed.seconds}, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE METERS = VALUES(METERS) , SECONDS = VALUES(SECONDS) , FIRST_SEEN = COALESCE(FIRST_SEEN, VALUES(FIRST_SEEN)) , LAST_SEEN = NOW()
